## Design rationale (moved out of the description to keep it under the plan-review admission limit)

**Why a dedicated resolver, not `config.repo_root_or_none()`.** `repo_root_or_none()` is explicit > `REBAR_ROOT` > git-toplevel-of-**cwd**. Its non-`REBAR_ROOT` fallback reads the child's CWD, so it only lands on the durable checkout if the child's cwd is anchored there — it leans on `detached_child_cwd` behaviour and re-runs the worktree-durability class (bugs 3198/93a9) if the cwd is a dying `make worktree` toplevel. The operator-approved `dirname(canonical tracker)` is durable independent of cwd: `StorePaths(tracker).canonical` realpath-resolves the worktree `.tickets-tracker` symlink back to the durable main checkout store, and its dirname is that checkout.

**Rejected alternatives.**
- Threading the caller's resolved `repo_root` from `maybe_compact` through the spawn contract — the parent's root is the DYING worktree; a `make worktree` git-toplevel can be deleted out from under the running detached child (durability class 3198/93a9).
- `config.repo_root_or_none()` — git-toplevel-of-cwd fallback, see above.
- `snapshot_repo_root()` — adds a snapshot-specific `"."` fallback `run_sweep` does not want; a code root that silently becomes cwd is the fatherly-incoherent-mare outage shape.

**Topology coverage.** Deployment (relocated store): `REBAR_ROOT` is exported unconditionally (`infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp:102`; `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:294` places it outside the PAT guard) naming the provisioned checkout `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code`, so the first precedence arm resolves it. Local `make worktree` (co-located symlink store, `REBAR_ROOT` may be unset): the fallback arm resolves via `dirname(canonical tracker)`.

**Scope boundaries.** Relates to ADR 0051 (foreground git maintenance never detached — this child does config resolution only). Does NOT overlap flowered-basaltic-beagle (088b-e4c1-050c-4516) realpath/abspath config-root family: this fix routes through `StorePaths.canonical`, not a raw realpath/abspath wrapper, so it adds no new per-site realpath decision of that kind.

**P2 note (review):** the plan-review advisory overlap flags `1a33-8b6a-5bf2-4ab6` also touches `src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py` (confidence 0.72). Left unlinked deliberately — my change only APPENDS a new leaf resolver and does not depend on 1a33's work; adding a `depends_on` would serialise unrelated tickets. Escalate if 1a33 turns out to edit the same region.
